CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  TUESDAY, APRIL 14, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

Mary Zendejas, 1st District  Megan Kerr, 5th District
Cindy Allen, 2nd District  Dr. Suely Saro, 6th District
Kristina Duggan, 3rd District  Roberto Uranga, Vice Mayor, 7th District
Daryl Supernaw, 4th District  Tunua Thrash-Ntuk, 8th District
  Dr. Joni Ricks-Oddie, 9th District
Thomas B. Modica, City Manager
Monique De La Garza, City Clerk  Rex Richardson, Mayor  Dawn McIntosh, City Attorney

  Members of the public have the option to submit online and email public comments to
  CityClerk@longbeach.gov

  To view the meeting from your computer, tablet, or smartphone
  visit: https://longbeach.primegov.com/public/portal?fromiframe=true

 Para escuchar la reunión del Concejo Municipal en español:

 1. Llame al (213) 338-8477
 2. Introduzca el ID de la reunión: 940 1533 4501 #
 3. Pulse # para unirse a la reunión

 Por favor, tenga en cuenta que, para proporcionar comentarios públicos, deberá asistir a la
 reunión presencial

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 CONSENT CALENDAR (1 – 10)

 1.  26-54839  Recommendation to increase appropriations in the General Fund Group in the City
  Manager Department by $6,900, offset by the Third Council District One-Time
  District Priority Funds, transferred from the Citywide Activities Department, to
  provide contributions of:
  1. $300 to the Black Employees Association of Long Beach for the Black
  History Month Celebration;
  2. $400 to LA County Youth Climate Commissioner, Mayra Catalán-Orozco for
  the Picnic For The Planet Event;
  3. $1,200 to the Greenbelt Heights Neighborhood Association for a 2026 Chili
  Cook-Off Block Party;
  4. $5,000 to Live at the Shell for continued activation of the Recreation Park
  Bandshell; and

  Decrease appropriations in the General Fund Group in the Citywide Activities
  Department by $6,900, to offset a transfer to the City Manager Department.

  Office or Department:  Kristina Duggan, Councilmember, Third District

  Page 1 of 9
   CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  TUESDAY, APRIL 14, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54840  Recommendation to increase appropriations in the General Fund Group in the City
  Manager Department by $12,600, offset by the Seventh Council District One-Time
  District Priority Funds transferred from the Citywide Activities Department, to
  support the following:
  1. $2,600 to California State University, Long Beach in support of the CSULB
  Latine Resource Center’s Nuestra Graduación Celebration;
  2. $10,000 to The Nonprofit Partnership in support of Westside Promise
  Collaborative meetings; and

  Decrease appropriations in the General Fund Group in the Citywide Activities
  Department by $12,600, to offset a transfer to the City Manager Department.

  Office or Department:  Roberto Uranga, Vice Mayor, Seventh District

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-54827  Recommendation to receive and file Proposition H Audit Report for the fiscal year
  ending on September 30, 2025.

  Office or Department:  City Auditor

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-54842  Recommendation to refer to City Attorney damage claims received between March
  30, 2026 and April 6, 2026.

  Office or Department:  City Clerk

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-54828  Recommendation to approve the destruction of records for the Legislative
  Department, Office of the Mayor; and adopt resolution.

  Office or Department:  City Clerk

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  26-54782  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute necessary
  documents including any subsequent amendments, extending the grant term or
  changing the amount of the award, with Marathon Petroleum Foundation, Inc.,
  Community Investment Grant Program, to accept and expend grant funding up to
  $8,000, from the Emergency Official Grant Program funds for Station 12 First

  Page 2 of 9
   CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  TUESDAY, APRIL 14, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  Responders Wellness and Station Maintenance for the period of January 1, 2026,
  through December 31, 2026; and increase appropriations in the General Grants
  Fund Group in the Fire Department by $8,000, offset by grant revenue. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Fire Department

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  26-54779  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute an
  agreement and all necessary documents, including any amendments to the
  allocation amount, with the County of Los Angeles, to accept and expend County
  Measure B funds in the amount of $1,500,000, to support ongoing bioterrorism
  response programs, for a two-year period, through June 30, 2027; and

  Increase appropriations in the Health Fund Group in the Health and Human
  Services Department by $1,500,000, offset by reimbursement revenue. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Health and Human Services

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  26-54781  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute an Affiliation
  Agreement, and any subsequent amendments, with the University of New
  England, for student field placement, internship and preceptorship with the Health
  and Human Services Department for a period of three years upon execution, with
  the option to renew for five additional three-year periods at the discretion of the
  City Manager, or designee. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Health and Human Services

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

9.  26-54783  Recommendation to adopt resolution amending the Fiscal Year 2026 Salary
  Resolution (No. RES-25-0125) to add, delete and modify position titles, add
  clarifying language, remove Attachment C, and align the professional ranges with
  minimum wage. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Human Resources

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

10. 26-54784  Recommendation to receive and file the application of Second LB, LLC, dba
  Hironori Craft Ramen, for an original application of an Alcoholic Beverage Control
  (ABC) License, at 5718 East 7th St, submit a Public Notice of Protest to ABC; and
  direct City Manager to withdraw the protest if a Conditional Use Permit (CUP) is

  Page 3 of 9
   CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  TUESDAY, APRIL 14, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  granted. (District 3)

  Levine Act: Yes

  Office or Department:  Police Department

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

CEREMONIALS AND PRESENTATIONS

  National Public Safety Telecommunications Week

  Cambodian New Year

  Public Health Month

CONTINUED HEARING

11. 26-54243  Recommendation to receive supporting documentation into the record, conclude
  the public hearing, review and determine that the proposed Zoning Code
  Amendment and Local Coastal Program Amendment are exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15061(b)(3)
  (Common Sense Exemption) of the State CEQA Guidelines, as it will not result
  directly or indirectly in significant environmental impacts (SE-25-142);

  Declare ordinance approving Zoning Code Amendment (ZCA25-001), and adopt
  the proposed findings related thereto, to amend Long Beach Municipal Code
  (LBMC) Chapters 21.15 and 21.51 of Title 21 (Zoning) to introduce and establish
  new regulations for Microenterprise Home Kitchen Operations (MEHKOs) to
  support proposed changes to Title 5 (Regulation of Businesses, Trades and
  Professions), read the first time and laid over to the next regular meeting of the
  City Council for final reading; and

  26-54244  Adopt resolution supporting a Local Coastal Program Amendment (LCPA25-001)
  to implement the establishment of new regulations for MEHKOS in Title 21
  (Zoning) to implement proposed changes of Title 5 of the LBMC and authorizing
  City Manager, or designee, to submit LCPA25-001, and associated materials and
  findings, related to changes to Title 21 of the LBMC to the California Coastal
  Commission for its review and certification in compliance with the Certified Local
  Coastal Program. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Community Development

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 4 of 9
   CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  TUESDAY, APRIL 14, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

PUBLIC COMMENT: Obtain speaker card from the City Clerk
Opportunity to address the City Council (on non-agenda items) is given to the first 10 persons who
submit Speaker Cards to the City Clerk beginning at 15 minutes prior to the commencement of the
meeting. Each speaker is allowed three minutes to make their comments.

UNFINISHED BUSINESS

12. 26-54465  Recommendation to declare ordinance amending Title 5 of the Long Beach
  Municipal Code - Regulation of Businesses, Trades, and Professions, amending
  and restating Chapter 5.35, all relating to Microenterprise Home Kitchen
  Operations, read the first time and laid over to the next regular meeting of the City
  Council for a final reading. Approval of this ordinance will create a program that
  permits home-based food facilities to prepare and sell meals directly to consumers.
  (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Health and Human Services

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

REGULAR AGENDA

13. 26-54785  Recommendation to adopt Specifications No. RFP ED-25-591 and award a
  contract to Contemporary Services Corporation, of Northridge, CA, for providing
  as-needed security services supporting special events produced by the City, as
  well as concerts and other events held at the Long Beach Amphitheater and
  additional special events hosted on the Queen Mary campus, in an annual amount
  not to exceed $3,000,000, for a period of six years, with the option to renew for
  four additional one-year periods, at the discretion of the City Manager; and,
  authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute all documents necessary to enter
  into the contract, including any necessary subsequent amendments. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Economic Development and Opportunity

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

14. 26-54786  Recommendation to adopt Specifications No. RFP ED-25-612 and award a
  contract to Sound Diplomacy, Inc., of Wilmington, DE, for the development of an
  Entertainment Strategic Plan, in an amount of $125,000, authorize a 10 percent
  contingency in the amount of $12,500, for a total contract amount not to exceed
  $137,500, for a period of one year; and, authorize City Manager, or designee, to
  execute all documents necessary to enter into the contract, including any
  necessary subsequent amendments. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Economic Development and Opportunity

  Page 5 of 9
   CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  TUESDAY, APRIL 14, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

15. 26-54780  Recommendation to adopt Specifications No. RFP HSB-2026-001 and award a
  contract to Jovenes, Inc., of Los Angeles, CA, for providing Interim Housing
  operations and support services for the Transitional Age Youth Navigation Center,
  in a total annual amount not to exceed $565,020, for a period of one year
  beginning April 1, 2026, with the option to renew for two additional one-year
  periods, at the discretion of the City Manager; and authorize City Manager, or
  designee, to execute all documents necessary to enter into the contract, including
  any necessary subsequent amendments. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Health and Human Services

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

ORDINANCE

16. 26-54841  Recommendation to declare ordinance amending and restating Chapter 5.95 of the
  Long Beach Municipal Code relating to third-party food delivery service fees, read
  the first time and laid over to the next regular meeting of the City Council for a final
  reading. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  City Attorney

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT: Immediately prior to adjournment
Opportunity is given to those members of the public who have not addressed the City Council on
non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to three minutes unless extended by the City Council.

STANDING COMMITTEE REMINDER

Tuesday, April 14, 2026 – Economic Development and Opportunity Committee at 3:00 P.M., Civic
Chambers.

Tuesday, April 21, 2026 – Government Operations and Efficiency Committee at 3:30 P.M., Civic
Chambers.

Tuesday, April 21, 2026 – Government Operations and Efficiency Committee (Attorney/Client) at
4:15 P.M., Beach Conference Rm.

HEARING REMINDER

  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

Tuesday, April 21, 2026 – Continued Hearing for Consideration of a Zoning Code Amendment and

Facilities (i.e. Mobile Food Trucks) Ordinance. (Citywide)

Notice to the public: The consent calendar shall be heard immediately after the pledge of
allegiance, and prior to 6:30 PM. All matters listed under the Consent Calendar are to be considered
routine by the City Council and will all be enacted by one motion. Long Beach Municipal Code Chapter 2.03

The City Council agenda and supporting documents are available on the Internet at
www.longbeach.gov. Agenda items may also be reviewed in the Office of the City Clerk or online at

should subscribe to the City of Long Beach LinkLB System at www.longbeach.gov/linklb.

of the City Council after the posting of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office
of the City Clerk during normal business hours and available on the internet at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings.
